projects.name: nexium
projects.tagline: A programming language of my own — compiles to native code through C, with automatic reference counting (no tracing GC) and a machine-checked effect system that says what a function is allowed to do. Self-hosting compiler.

projects.name: gesture-synth
projects.tagline: A chord instrument you play with your hands in front of a camera. MediaPipe hand-tracking drives a synth; loop it and watch the harmony. A monorepo spanning Rust/WASM, Svelte + Three.js, a Tauri app, a Zig DSP kernel, and a Gleam service.

projects.name: capture-bypass
projects.tagline: DLL-injection tool that bypasses screen-capture protection on Windows 10/11. Multi-crate workspace, egui GUI, Inno installer.

projects.name: HideDesktopApps
projects.tagline: Tray utility to hide desktop icons, taskbar, and windows via hotkeys — for ricing, Wallpaper Engine, and presentations.

projects.name: clipvault
projects.tagline: Keyboard-first clipboard-manager daemon: system-wide capture, ring buffer, hotkey overlay.

projects.name: pc-optimizer
projects.tagline: "PC Optimizer Pro" — Windows tweak, fan-control, RGB, and debloat suite living in the tray.

projects.name: drugdose
projects.tagline: EMS & clinical drug-dosing calculator — weight-based dosing, 49-drug database, interaction rules.

projects.name: vitalscore
projects.tagline: Clinical scoring calculators — severity and triage scores as a clean Python API.

projects.name: Clinical_IQ
projects.tagline: Point-of-care decision support for emergency medicine.

projects.name: akribia
projects.tagline: Computational model of precision-weighted Bayesian inference across autism, ADHD, and PPCS — with a live in-browser demo.

projects.name: DiresQ
projects.tagline: Disaster-response app that tracks the responders, not just the incidents — join a report, check in on a timer, and the accountability board turns red if you go dark. Flask backend, built at Katy Youth Hacks 2026.

projects.name: ropesim
projects.tagline: Models lead-fall dynamics with a damped spring / RK4 integrator in Rust, exposed to Python via PyO3/Maturin. Ships a full Python API, a five-command CLI, and a PySide6 desktop GUI.

projects.name: apollo-rope-memory
projects.tagline: Working replica of Apollo-era core rope memory — ferrite toroids, induction read, comparator front-end.

projects.name: pygeospy
projects.tagline: GEOINT/OSINT library, Rust-accelerated — SAR grids, EXIF, and terrain analysis.

projects.name: qbit-killswitch
projects.tagline: VPN killswitch daemon for qBittorrent — pauses torrents the instant your public IP changes. Cross-platform tray app.

projects.name: mullvad-wg-monitor
projects.tagline: Benchmarks and monitors Mullvad WireGuard endpoints.

projects.name: patchnotes
projects.tagline: Parser and tooling for Keep a Changelog changelogs.

projects.name: timefuzz
projects.tagline: Fuzzy natural-language time parsing that goes past dateparser — resolves phrases like "end of Q3" or "the Tuesday after my birthday" into datetimes or ranges, each with a confidence score. Rust core, Python API.

projects.name: Live_Video_Feed_Facial_Recognition
projects.tagline: Real-time facial recognition pipeline running on a live webcam or video feed.

projects.name: convo-generator
projects.tagline: Conversation and dialogue generator.

projects.name: kto
projects.tagline: "Kick Them Out" v3 — WiFi security-assessment tool with CLI, TUI, and GUI. Authorized use only.

projects.name: deadpoint
projects.tagline: Purple-team RNG analysis toolkit — detects predictable randomness (MT19937, LCG, xorshift), recovers the generator's state to prove it, then recommends the fix. Embedded/OT audit framing.

projects.name: ValoTracker
projects.tagline: Real-time VALORANT match tracker — 10-player ranks, stats, and encounter history. Reads only 127.0.0.1, no login.

projects.name: IEM-Tool-rs
projects.tagline: Offline desktop tool for reviewing, tuning, and comparing in-ear monitors — Rust core, Tauri app, cross-platform builds. Based on IEM Tool by MyLittlePrimordia.

projects.name: whumpf
projects.tagline: Avalanche bulletins projected onto the real mountain in 3D. Slope, aspect, and elevation are packed into RGBA tiles and filtered in a GLSL shader, so a whole range recomputes as you drag a slider. Sentinel-2 / LiDAR, CesiumJS.

projects.name: filekind
projects.tagline: Make a custom file extension a real, recognised file type — on Windows, Linux and macOS — from one declarative spec. Generates the registry tree, freedesktop MIME XML, macOS UTI plist, icons in three formats, and the install/remove scripts. Rust core, Tauri app + CLI.

projects.name: beam
projects.tagline: Send files and text between devices, browser to browser, by scanning a QR code. A direct WebRTC connection — no accounts, no uploads, no server of your own. A handful of static files on GitHub Pages.

projects.name: claude-skills
projects.tagline: The whole rollcall family in one install — skill-rollcall, mcp-rollcall, settings-effective, git-attribution. Each stays synced from its own upstream repo, pinned and drift-checked in CI.

projects.name: skill-rollcall
projects.tagline: Roll call of your Claude Code skills — who is here, who is new, who is never going to show up, and why. Rebuilds the skill index from disk with the reasons attached, then repairs, lints, or audits. Runs as a skill and a CLI.

projects.name: mcp-rollcall
projects.tagline: Roll call of your MCP servers — which will fail to connect and exactly why (bad paths, unset env, dead ports, the server’s own stderr), and what each one costs you in tools and context.

projects.name: settings-effective
projects.tagline: The Claude Code settings actually in effect — every key, which of the six settings files decided it, and why the value you set is not applying.

projects.name: git-attribution
projects.tagline: Find and remove AI co-author attribution from your git history — whether Claude Code is still adding it, which commits carry it, scrub them, and block it going forward.

projects.name: statusmith
projects.tagline: Write your own Discord Rich Presence from the tray — details, images, timers, party size and buttons, with saved presets, live variables and rotation. Talks to Discord’s local RPC pipe the way a game does, so it never sees your account token. Tauri 2, cross-platform, ships a Nexium SDK.
